I thought the title was misleading. This doesn't mean that all children have to be inoculated regardless of the parent's/guardian's beliefs. It means that children no longer require consent from their parents/guardians in order to be inoculated.

Basically, the default position is now that children will be inoculated unless their parents/guardians say otherwise.

A written consent of children's legal guardians is no longer necessary to inoculate children in Serbia after parliament passed a law making this obligatory.
